description: Adjudicate a multi-annotated Open Label task's consensus group — the same DETERMINE/REFINE core as the review UI's trophy/compose flow. DETERMINE awards one submission (from open_label_task_consensus) as ground truth; the demoted sets stay on record. REFINE records that a merged answer was composed separately. Requires open-label:write scope + the review_decide capability.

mode.description: DETERMINE = trophy; REFINE = merged answer recorded.

resultJson.description: REFINE compose: the merged answer regions to persist as the GROUND_TRUTH final answer. REFINE without resultJson requires an existing composed ground-truth answer.

winningSubmissionId.description: Required for DETERMINE: the winning submission id from open_label_task_consensus.

name: open_label_adjudicate_consensus
